lookback_summary:
Well, what a weekend that was! The model really had its ups and downs, didn't it? I mean, who saw Leeds absolutely dismantling Newcastle 4-1? That was a real shocker and the model definitely missed the mark there. On the flip side, it nailed the Manchester derby, predicting a tight 1-0 win for City over United—spot on! 

And how about Brighton's stunning 5-0 demolition of Coventry? The model called that one right, just like it did for Arsenal’s solid win over Sunderland. However, I had to eat humble pie when Liverpool and Chelsea both dropped points at home; those were supposed to be bankers! Overall, a mixed bag, but that's football for you—always keeping us on our toes!
